about: an empty chat message; OpenAI refuses a thread message with empty content

error.message: Invalid 'thread.messages[0].content': empty string. Expected a string with minimum length 1, but got an empty string instead.

connectorGaps: assistant answer: the Assistants API's run and thread are the service's own, with no connector counterpart
reads.note: OpenAI node v1.8, assistant message with the memory connector (empty on the first turn): LangChain's OpenAIAssistantRunnable POSTs /v1/threads/runs (createAndRun: thread with the user message, assistant_id), GETs /v1/threads/{thread}/runs/{run} until the status is not queued or in_progress (again after the memory is saved, for usage), then GETs /v1/threads/{thread}/messages?order=desc and keeps the run's assistant messages. The assistant's answer is the service's reply here, not a model the shim answers (the node's assistant resource is not a text model call)

branches: no IF/Switch: the run is refused (400), so OpenAI Assistent is expected to fail in n8n
expect.offline: The assistant (asst_vvkn…) and its attached travel document live at OpenAI; its answers are fixed here. Window Buffer Memory is empty at the start of every run (README: process memory restarts), so no thread is pre-created. The manual branch (Drive download, file upload, assistant create and update) has its own trigger and is not run
